# Access Your Place

> Access Your Place helps people run full-service furnished rental operations without buying the property. We find furnished and flexible rental opportunities, check them with the landlord, negotiate the lease, and set the unit up with our own logistics network and team. We also list running furnished rental businesses for sale. Operations in the United States and Mexico. A Set Up Your Place LLC company.

Street addresses of listings are private until a client commits. Every listing marked verified has been checked with the landlord and reviewed by our team. We project revenue; we do not guarantee it.

## Main pages

- [Deals](https://accessyourplace.com/deals): furnished rental deals and running operations for sale
- [Get started](https://accessyourplace.com/start): sell an operation, acquire a property, book setup or teardown, or list a property as a landlord or apartment community
- [How it works](https://accessyourplace.com/how-it-works): Acquisition Managers, Setup Managers and the Success Team
- [Setup services](https://accessyourplace.com/setup-services): furnishing and launching a unit
- [Landlord partnership](https://accessyourplace.com/landlord-partnership): for landlords, property managers and apartment communities
- [Knowledge library](https://accessyourplace.com/knowledge-library): guides and city-by-city furnished rental regulations with sources
- [Penny](https://accessyourplace.com/penny-ai): the deal assistant

## The company

- [Set Up Your Place LLC](https://accessyourplace.com/setupyourplace): the technology company behind Access Your Place, Access YP Labs and Access YP Flow, founded by Vission and Rel Cooper
- [Accessibility](https://accessyourplace.com/setupyourplace/accessibility)
- [Careers](https://accessyourplace.com/setupyourplace/careers)
- [Press](https://accessyourplace.com/setupyourplace/press)
- [Access YP Labs](https://accessyplabs.com): a small business back office run by Penny
- [Access YP Flow](https://accessypflow.com): bookkeeping and cash flow with Arbo. Keeps the books for every business and property, works out what is genuinely spare, bills and chases customers, and can put spare cash to work in the owner's own accounts
